content.text: Hold a Furusiyaa Tournament is a Realm decision available to Muslim characters.
The decision requires to be adult, male, at peace, 500 prestige and 200 Wealth.
If a war is declared, the tournament is cancelled, 200 Wealth is refunded, lose 100 Prestige, gain 5 Decadence.
Invitation to the tournament are sent to Feudal, Tribal and Nomadic characters of ages between 16 and 50.
Adds a Chronicle entry.
AI requires at least 3 years of income or 1000 Wealth to take this decision.
Participating grants 50 Prestige, not participating costs 100 Prestige.
Participants get one event in the following table:

Characters attending the tournament either win or lose 50, 100 Prestige or 1 Martial.
With The Reaper's Due DLC, gain 15 Prosperity on capital county.
Winners are determined purely by Personal Combat Skill.

items.text: First place gets 100 Wealth, 300 Prestige, -3 Decadence
Second place gets 75 Wealth, 250 Prestige, -2 Decadence
Third place gets 50 Wealth, 200 Prestige, -1 Decadence
